g.text: FH-HVAC Node — Complete Fritzing Wiring & Schematic
GPIO / SPI / I2C / PWM / ADC Signals
1. Temp/Humidity Sensor (GPIO 4): Bench uses 3-pin Keyestudio DHT11 module (built-in 10k pull-up, 3.3V). Docs/Wokwi list DHT22; Ignition saw tenths (status open item).
2. Compressor/Fan Relay (GPIO 26): Keyestudio 1-ch 5V Relay (bench-confirmed active-HIGH). COM -> 5V supply, NO -> Fan Motor (+) with 1N4007 flyback diode (stripe -> NO/+).
3. Status RGB LED (Common Cathode): R=GPIO 16, G=GPIO 17, B=GPIO 18 via 3x 220 ohm resistors (WROOM DevKit required; WROVER uses GPIO 16/17 for PSRAM).
